name: Hillary
source:
A client of Ida's personal training business. Ida is her personal trainer. 

Their business relationship has also started developing into a budding friendship. 

She has struggled with being twenty kilos overweight after her recent pregnancy. Ida has helped her to lose 10 kilos so far.
